diagnosis: The check C5 passed in all rollouts despite PF3 not being available to any of the lone decision-makers. This indicates that the model is defaulting to a setting where cross-region US fallback is disabled, likely due to a heuristic or default value in the model’s decision-making process.

C5.why: Without PF3 a general regional deployment with US failover appears acceptable, whereas PF3 changes the processing region to eu-west-1 and requires cross-region US fallback to be disabled.
